arabic_html:
وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْحَىِّ ٱلَّذِى لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهِۦ ۚ
وَكَفَىٰ بِهِۦ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًا ۞
translation: And rely upon the Ever-Living who does not die, and glorify Him with praise. And He is sufficient as One Aware of the sins of His servants.
explanation_html: Everything you lean on can fail you — except One. Ibn Kathīr: put your trust in the Ever-Living who never dies, and He will be sufficient — your helper and support.
